description: Attacker embeds malicious instructions in user input that override the agent's system prompt or intended behavior.
impact: Unauthorized actions, data leakage, safety bypass
real_world_incidents: Bing Chat DAN jailbreak 2023; ChatGPT markdown injection

description: Hidden malicious instructions in external content (websites, emails, documents) that an agent reads, hijacking its subsequent actions.
impact: Agent hijacking, data exfiltration, unauthorized actions
real_world_incidents: Greshake et al. arXiv:2302.12173; Microsoft Copilot email injection PoC

description: Attacker registers or modifies an agent's available tools to perform malicious actions while appearing legitimate.
impact: Data exfiltration, arbitrary code execution, lateral movement
real_world_incidents: Invariant Labs MCP Tool Poisoning PoC 2025

description: Injection of malicious 'memories' into the agent's persistent memory store (vector DB) that surface in future sessions to influence decisions.
impact: Persistent agent compromise, biased future decisions, backdoor implantation

description: Attacker uploads or injects malicious documents into the agent's Retrieval-Augmented Generation knowledge base to manipulate its responses.
real_world_incidents: NVIDIA AI Red Team Phantom Documents attack 2024

description: Attacker takes full control of an autonomous agent's goal or action pipeline, redirecting it to perform attacker-defined tasks.
impact: Complete agent compromise, unauthorized actions at scale

description: Attacker bypasses model safety guardrails through role-play, persona-switching, or encoding tricks to elicit harmful outputs.
impact: Harmful content generation, safety bypass, policy violation

description: Malicious model weights with embedded backdoors uploaded to public model repositories (e.g., Hugging Face) and used in agent pipelines.
impact: Persistent backdoor, triggered malicious behavior, data exfiltration
real_world_incidents: Hugging Face malicious model uploads 2024; PyTorch torchvision supply chain 2022

description: Agent given excessive permissions (file system, email, database) is exploited via prompt injection to perform destructive or unauthorized operations.
impact: Data deletion, exfiltration, unauthorized system changes
real_world_incidents: LangChain Agent with shell tool privilege escalation PoC (2024)

description: Specially crafted complex or recursive prompts that force maximum token generation and compute usage, causing API timeouts or financial damage.
real_world_incidents: Sponge Examples attack (Shumailov et al. 2021); Token DoS on public endpoints

description: Attacker crafts prompts that cause the LLM to regurgitate memorized training data including PII, proprietary code, or sensitive information.
impact: PII leakage, IP theft, compliance violations (GDPR, HIPAA)
example_frameworks: OpenAI Agents SDK, General LLM APIs
real_world_incidents: Carlini et al. GPT-2 data extraction; Samsung code leak via ChatGPT 2023

description: In multi-agent systems, a compromised sub-agent sends malicious instructions upward to the orchestrator, taking over the entire agent pipeline.
impact: Full pipeline compromise, cascading unauthorized actions
